name: Microsoft Defender XDR — hunting playbook
description: Recurring hunting queries that need no indicator. Every template is parameterised on a time range so it can be widened during an investigation.

variables.label: Device name filter
variables.description: Leave empty for the whole estate, or type a device name to scope the hunt.

templates.name: Office applications spawning a shell or script host
templates.description: The classic maldoc execution chain. Very few legitimate reasons exist for Word or Excel to launch PowerShell.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe", "msaccess.exe", "onenote.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "curl.exe", "bitsadmin.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: PowerShell with an encoded command
templates.description: Encoded commands are legitimate in automation but rare interactively; review the decoded payload for every hit.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-[eE^]{1,2}[ncodeman]*\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: PowerShell with download or bypass arguments
templates.description: Catches the download cradles that do not bother to encode themselves.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DownloadString", "DownloadFile", "Invoke-WebRequest", "iwr ", "Net.WebClient", "BypassExecutionPolicy", "-ep bypass", "-nop", "FromBase64String", "IEX", "Invoke-Expression")
| summarize Hits = count(), Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5) by DeviceName, AccountName
| sort by Hits desc

templates.name: Living off the land binaries used to download
templates.description: certutil, bitsadmin, curl and friends fetching a remote payload.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where FileName in~ ("certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "curl.exe", "wget.exe", "mshta.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe", "msiexec.exe", "installutil.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://", "ftp://", "\\\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Executables launched from temporary or user folders
templates.description: Payloads normally run from Temp, Downloads, AppData or the recycle bin rather than from Program Files.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\", @"\\Downloads\\", @"\\AppData\\Roaming\\", @"\\$Recycle.Bin\\", @"C:\\Users\\Public\\", @"\\Windows\\Temp\\")
| where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".scr" or FileName endswith ".dll"
| summarize Executions = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 10)
          by FileName, FolderPath, SHA256
| sort by Executions desc

templates.name: Services installed
templates.description: New service creation is both a persistence and a lateral movement signal.
templates.body:
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where ActionType == "ServiceInstalled"
| extend ServiceName = tostring(AdditionalFields.ServiceName), ImagePath = tostring(AdditionalFields.ImagePath)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, ServiceName, ImagePath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Scheduled tasks created
templates.description: Includes both the schtasks command line and the native task registration event.
templates.body:
union
  (DeviceProcessEvents
   | where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
   | where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
   | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail = ProcessCommandLine),
  (DeviceEvents
   | where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
   | where ActionType == "ScheduledTaskCreated"
   | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail = tostring(AdditionalFields))
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Autorun registry keys modified
templates.description: Writes into Run, RunOnce and the Winlogon shell keys.
templates.body:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\\CurrentVersion\\Run", @"\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce", @"\\Winlogon", @"\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Shell Folders", @"\\Image File Execution Options")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessFileName
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Processes reading LSASS memory
templates.description: Credential dumping. Expect noise from legitimate security tooling: baseline it once and keep the exclusions in the query.
templates.body:
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where ActionType == "OpenProcessApiCall"
| where FileName =~ "lsass.exe"
| where not (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("MsMpEng.exe", "MsSense.exe", "csrss.exe", "wininit.exe", "services.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Shadow copies deleted or recovery disabled
templates.description: Late stage ransomware behaviour. Treat every hit as an incident until proven otherwise.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled", "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Failed logons per account and source
templates.description: Triage table for brute force and spray activity.
templates.body:
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| summarize Failures = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), Accounts = dcount(AccountName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by RemoteIP, AccountName
| where Failures > 5
| sort by Failures desc

templates.name: Successful logon after repeated failures
templates.description: The pattern that matters: many failures followed by a success from the same source.
templates.body:
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| summarize Failures = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed"),
            Successes = countif(ActionType == "LogonSuccess"),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 20)
          by RemoteIP
| where Failures >= 10 and Successes > 0
| sort by Failures desc

templates.name: Accounts added to a local administrators group
templates.description: Privilege escalation and persistence in one event.
templates.body:
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where ActionType in ("UserAccountAddedToLocalGroup", "UserAccountCreated")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, AccountName, AdditionalFields, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Archives created by command line tools
templates.description: Data staged before exfiltration usually gets compressed first.
templates.body:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where FileName in~ ("7z.exe", "7za.exe", "rar.exe", "winrar.exe", "zip.exe", "tar.exe", "makecab.exe")
     or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "Compress-Archive")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc

templates.name: Largest outbound transfers per device
templates.description: Ranks external destinations by connection volume, as a cheap proxy for exfiltration.
templates.body:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| summarize Connections = count(), Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| sort by Connections desc
| take 100

templates.name: Antivirus detections that were not remediated
templates.description: Detections where the action failed or was only partially applied — these silently stay on the estate.
templates.body:
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{var:range}})
| where ActionType startswith "AntivirusDetection"
| extend ThreatName = tostring(AdditionalFields.ThreatName), WasRemediated = tostring(AdditionalFields.WasRemediated)
| where WasRemediated != "true"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ThreatName, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256, WasRemediated
| sort by Timestamp desc
